select b.blog_id, b.author_id, u.nick_name as author_nickname, b.title, b.summary, b.cover_url, b.publish_time, b.view_count, b.like_count, b.collect_count from blog b left join sys_user u on b.author_id = u.user_id
inner join blog_tag bt on bt.blog_id = b.blog_id
where
and MATCH(b.title, b.content) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN BOOLEAN MODE)
and b.author_id = #{authorId}
and bt.tag_id in #{tid} group by b.blog_id having count(distinct bt.tag_id) = #{tagIds.size()}
order by (b.like_count * 2 + b.collect_count * 3 + b.view_count) desc, b.publish_time desc, b.blog_id desc
order by b.publish_time desc, b.blog_id desc
order by MATCH(b.title, b.content) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) desc, b.publish_time desc, b.blog_id desc
order by b.publish_time desc, b.blog_id desc

select b.blog_id, b.author_id, u.nick_name as author_nickname, b.title, b.summary, b.cover_url, b.publish_time, b.view_count, b.like_count, b.collect_count from blog b left join sys_user u on b.author_id = u.user_id where and b.blog_id in #{bid}

select b.blog_id, b.author_id, u.nick_name as author_nickname, b.title, b.summary, b.cover_url, b.publish_time, b.view_count, b.like_count, b.collect_count, b.level from blog b left join sys_user u on b.author_id = u.user_id where b.deleted = 0 and b.status = 'PUBLISHED' and b.blog_id = #{blogId}
select content from blog where blog_id = #{blogId}

select b.blog_id, b.author_id, u.nick_name as author_nickname, b.title, b.summary, b.cover_url, b.publish_time, b.view_count, b.like_count, b.collect_count from blog b left join sys_user u on b.author_id = u.user_id inner join blog_tag bt on bt.blog_id = b.blog_id where and bt.tag_id in (select tag_id from blog_tag where blog_id = #{blogId}) and b.blog_id <> #{blogId} group by b.blog_id order by (b.like_count * 2 + b.collect_count * 3 + b.view_count) desc, b.publish_time desc limit #{size}
select blog_id as blogId, tag_id as tagId from blog_tag where blog_id in #{bid}

select t.tag_id as tagId, t.tag_name as tagName, sum(cnt) as contentCount, sum(score) as hotScore from ( select bt.tag_id, count(distinct b.blog_id) as cnt, sum(b.like_count * 2 + b.collect_count * 3 + b.view_count) as score from blog_tag bt inner join blog b on b.blog_id = bt.blog_id where b.deleted = 0 and b.status = 'PUBLISHED' and b.level = 1 group by bt.tag_id union all select at2.tag_id, count(distinct a.article_id) as cnt, sum(a.like_count * 2 + a.collect_count * 3 + a.view_count) as score from article_tag at2 inner join article a on a.article_id = at2.article_id where a.deleted = 0 and a.status = 'PUBLISHED' and a.visibility = 'PUBLIC' group by at2.tag_id ) merged inner join tag t on t.tag_id = merged.tag_id where t.deleted = 0 and t.status = 1 group by t.tag_id, t.tag_name order by hotScore desc, contentCount desc, t.tag_id asc limit #{size}

select tag_id from ( select bt.tag_id, sum(w) as weight from ( select bt.tag_id, 1 as w from blog_like bl inner join blog_tag bt on bt.blog_id = bl.blog_id where bl.user_id = #{userId} union all select bt.tag_id, 3 as w from blog_collect bc inner join blog_tag bt on bt.blog_id = bc.blog_id where bc.user_id = #{userId} union all select at2.tag_id, 1 as w from user_view_history h inner join article_tag at2 on at2.article_id = h.biz_id where h.user_id = #{userId} and h.biz_type = 'ARTICLE' ) bt group by bt.tag_id ) merged group by tag_id order by weight desc limit #{topN}
select biz_id from user_view_history where user_id = #{userId} and biz_type = 'BLOG'

select (select count(*) from blog b where b.deleted = 0 and b.status = 'PUBLISHED' and b.level <= #{userViewLevel}) as publishedBlogCount, (select cast(coalesce(sum(b.view_count), 0) as unsigned) from blog b where b.deleted = 0 and b.status = 'PUBLISHED' and b.level <= #{userViewLevel}) as totalReads, (select count(*) from tag t where t.deleted = 0 and t.status = 1) as tagCount
